owner_objective: Final exact-head release audit for V8. Preserve V6 as the exact frozen ten-coin Core regression anchor. V8 is the current 15-market product: unchanged V6 Core plus five Satellite profiles, with only NEARUSDC/BCHUSDC active as strict Core-idle gap fillers and SUIUSDC/UNIUSDC/AAVEUSDC research-only. Verify rolling three-year point-in-time/no-lookahead evidence, 2x50-percent modular capital scaling, Backtest/Paper/Live/UI parity, full regression and fail-closed safety. Promote code to gpt/usdc-audit only after same-head A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS. Do not activate Live or send orders.

acceptance.exact_head: All A01-A11 reports, integration evidence and release evidence must reference one exact candidate commit. Any patch invalidates the round.
acceptance.frozen_v6: V6_COIN_STRATEGY remains the exact ten-coin regression anchor with unchanged profile behavior/version hash.
acceptance.current_v8: V8 is the current product; its first ten Core profiles/policies must equal V6 exactly and its five Satellite profiles are a separate layer.
acceptance.satellite_roles: Only NEARUSDC and BCHUSDC are shared-active; SUIUSDC, UNIUSDC and AAVEUSDC are research-only and cannot allocate capital.
acceptance.idle_contract: Satellites enter only with a completely idle Core; an executable Core entry reclaims required Satellite capital at the next executable open.
acceptance.capital_modularity: Configured max capital X derives exactly two X/2 slots. 250/125 and 1000/500 are examples only.
acceptance.future_safety: Decisions use finalized 1h bars only. Report end is the last fully closed UTC hour; report start is exactly three calendar years earlier; 400 prior bars are warmup. Future/holdout outcomes never steer runtime decisions.
acceptance.economics: Fresh baseline/stress evidence must preserve Core behavior and show the accepted Satellite layer is non-regressive on Shared profit/drawdown; trade count alone cannot pass.
acceptance.paper_live_parity: Paper and Live must implement the same V8 role/routing/capital semantics as the accepted backtest and remain fail-closed on identity/reconciliation mismatches.
acceptance.ui: Source UI and shipped bundle must expose V8 as current and label Core, shared-active Satellites and research-only Satellites accurately.
acceptance.paper_state: Persistent Paper state must be integral. If stale because runtime is paused, agents must report catch-up required before resume rather than silently reset it.
acceptance.exchange: A07 verifies current public Binance USDC availability/rules for the configured V8 universe and supported modular tranche sizes.
acceptance.qa: A09 requires fresh exact-head full regression, integration and specialist evidence before QA_PASS.
acceptance.governance: A11 requires same-head QA_PASS and complete A01-A10 evidence before GOVERNANCE_PASS.
acceptance.promotion: Same-head QA_PASS plus GOVERNANCE_PASS authorizes code promotion to gpt/usdc-audit only. Paper activation/catch-up is separately audited and Live remains disabled.
acceptance.live_safety: No private credential changes, no testnet orders, no real-money orders, no automatic Live arming.
